name: Varlık derinliği ve kamera

local_gate.web_gates: web is not in the -Fast table, so run by hand: tsc --noEmit clean; vitest full suite 1886/1886 (105 files) after node scripts/web/sync-feature-matrix.mjs; oxlint on the changed files

measured_first.unreachable_rest: engine._bucket needs posture=='resting'; apps/web lib/eye/signal.ts derivePosture() returns 'unknown'; ambient/ingest.py input observations carry posture 'unknown'.
measured_first.policy_needs_camera: ambient/policy.py decide: display.off for LIKELY_ASLEEP also requires eye_enabled and perception_age_s <= camera_unknown_grace_s.
measured_first.no_history_route: presence routes: policy, state, observations, eye enable/disable, greeting; episodes in memory only.
measured_first.read_only_panel: AmbientPanel rendered the four switches as text; no PUT caller in the web app.
measured_first.tab_close: no pagehide handling in lib/eye; the server flag stayed enabled and ambient saw only perception_stale.

closed.301: POST /v1/presence/eye/stream-stopped (eye.stream_stopped), notifyEyeStreamStopped keepalive on pagehide while running.
closed.302_303: EyeControlView notice when server eye active and this tab's camera not running.
closed.331_332: AmbientPanel onToggle (AMBIENT_TOGGLES), updateAmbientPolicy PUT, cockpit + settings wiring.

found_on_the_way.sleep_policy_requires_camera: the display-off-while-asleep decision requires fresh camera perception on top of LIKELY_ASLEEP, so no non-camera signal could ever trigger 333 - inferring sleep from input idle was rejected for the same reason (ADR-0155 decision 1).
found_on_the_way.tab_close_silence: a closed camera tab left the server believing the eye was on until perception went stale; it is now evidence on the record.
found_on_the_way.sleep_flapped_back_to_rest: pre-B48: escalating to LIKELY_ASLEEP started that state's own clock, and the next reading re-measured the 20-minute threshold from it, so sleep lasted one reading before RESTING returned; sleep now holds while the rest evidence does (regression: the 30-minute night rest test, mutation M12).
found_on_the_way.impossible_quiet_hour: '25:00' parsed as minute 1500 and made a window every minute fell outside of; hours and minutes are range-checked and an impossible time changes nothing (mutation M13).
found_on_the_way.stream_stopped_crashed: the new route built its ledger event without source_ref and returned 500 on its first call; the route test caught it before any gate, and every stop now has its own ref.
found_on_the_way.decay_scaled_confidence: the first freshness weighting multiplied confidence down, which failed test_presence_engine's mild-conflict majority (0.343 < 0.35); it is a weighted average now.
found_on_the_way.route_tests_dialed_postgres: the first B48 route tests used the app's real database identity runtime; they now use the presence routes' own SQLite fixture shape.
found_on_the_way.badge_union_lost_broken: B45 closed the last BROKEN rows, the generated ImplClass union dropped BROKEN, and badges.ts's word for it became a TypeScript error that neither the fast gate (no web step) nor the badge vitest (no type check) could see; the implementation vocabulary is closed while its use is not.
found_on_the_way.family_page_panel_pin: the settings page's inline onToggle arrow put a '>' between <AmbientPanel and `always`, so tests/pages/family-pages.test.ts (req 699: the reused panel must stay visible) failed in the full web suite; the handler is a named callback and `always` is last. The same test's 'no family page can change what it shows' comment named routines as the only exception; it now names the ambient switches (ADR-0155 decision 5) and pins them to updateAmbientPolicy.

tests.services/api/tests/unit/test_presence_b4: freshness weighting (fresh-led > old-led, evenly aged keeps confidence) and decay=0 equivalence; quiet hours across midnight in their own zone; outside-quiet threshold; 30-minute rest = sleep at night / rest in the afternoon; owner quiet hours reach the engine on ingest; classify_window threshold; history route (list, 422 bound, owner gate); stream-stopped keeps consent
tests.apps/web/tests/eye/b48-web.test.tsx: tab notice only on server-on/local-off; toggles only with a handler, pressed state; PUT body and refusal words; keepalive stream-stopped, never a disable
tests.regression suites rerun: test_presence_* and test_ambient_* (430 passed), web tsc --noEmit clean, vitest eye/ cockpit/ features/ (604 passed); full suites: see local_gate

red_first_proof.method: Executed mutations restored from sha256-verified copies (never git checkout); scratchpad b48_mutate.py.
mutations: M1 an observation counts fully until the instant it expires again (310) -> 1 failure(s).
M2 an afternoon nap reads as sleep: the quiet window never lengthens the threshold (312) -> 1 failure(s).
M3 classify_window ignores the time of day (312) -> 1 failure(s).
M4 the owner's quiet hours never reach the engine (313) -> 1 failure(s).
M5 a quiet window crossing midnight is never inside (312) -> 1 failure(s).
M6 a closed camera tab withdraws the owner's consent (301) -> 1 failure(s).
M7 the history route reads an unbounded or zero limit (330) -> 1 failure(s).
M8 the 'camera not running here' notice shows while the camera runs (303) -> 1 failure(s).
M9 the ambient switches appear where the panel must stay read-only (331) -> 1 failure(s).
M10 the closing tab's notice dies with the page (no keepalive) (301) -> 1 failure(s).
M11 flipping one switch silently writes another (332) -> 1 failure(s).
M12 sleep lasts one reading, then the threshold is re-measured from its own start (312) -> 1 failure(s).
M13 an impossible quiet hour (25:00) is read as a real window (312) -> 1 failure(s).
red_first_proof.result: 13/13 red; every file restored to its sha256 before the mutation.

browser_check: Next dev server (launch config web, port 3210) compiled the changed pages with no server errors; /settings and /core/cockpit stop at the owner sign-in screen, and the only console errors were refused connections to the Cloud Core API (127.0.0.1:8001, not running). Reaching the ambient panel needs a live API and the owner credential, which is not entered by the agent; the switches, the tab notice and the keepalive are proven by apps/web/tests/eye/b48-web.test.tsx.

runtime_proof.status: PROVEN_AUTOMATED (pure engine, routes through create_app, web rendered with react-dom/server) plus a browser check of the panel and the eye control on the local web app. PROVEN_REAL for the posture signal and the sleep policy needs Karar 8.
